mapper.sql: select msg_id, recipient_id, mode, category, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, route, read_flag, read_time, del_flag, create_time from kg_message
mapper.select: select msg_id, recipient_id, mode, category, title, case when biz_type = 'chat_conv' then '（私信 / 群聊内容不在后台展示）' else content end as content, biz_type, biz_id, route, read_flag, read_time, del_flag, create_time from kg_message where msg_id = #{msgId} and del_flag = '0'

sql.if: and (kg_message.mode <> 'staff' or coalesce(kg_message.biz_type,'') not in ('chat_conv','application','online_submission','online_settlement','job','stay_order','merchant_request','activity','ops_daily','ops_monthly','ops_scope') or exists (select 1 from kg_store selected_store where selected_store.store_id in #{selectedId} and ( (kg_message.biz_type='chat_conv' and exists(select 1 from kg_chat_conv scoped_chat left join kg_activity scoped_activity on scoped_activity.activity_id=scoped_chat.activity_id where scoped_chat.conv_id=kg_message.biz_id and coalesce(scoped_chat.store_id,scoped_activity.store_id)=selected_store.store_id)) or (kg_message.biz_type in ('application','online_submission','online_settlement') and exists(select 1 from kg_application scoped_application join kg_job scoped_job on scoped_job.job_id=scoped_application.job_id where scoped_application.app_id=kg_message.biz_id and scoped_application.store_id=selected_store.store_id and (#{selectedMessageRole} not in ('online_staff','merchant_service') or scoped_job.job_type='online'))) or (kg_message.biz_type='job' and exists(select 1 from kg_job scoped_job where scoped_job.job_id=kg_message.biz_id and scoped_job.store_id=selected_store.store_id and (#{selectedMessageRole} not in ('online_staff','merchant_service') or scoped_job.job_type='online'))) or (kg_message.biz_type='stay_order' and exists(select 1 from kg_stay_order scoped_order where scoped_order.order_id=kg_message.biz_id and scoped_order.store_id=selected_store.store_id)) or (kg_message.biz_type='merchant_request' and exists(select 1 from kg_merchant_request scoped_request where scoped_request.request_id=kg_message.biz_id and scoped_request.store_id=selected_store.store_id)) or (kg_message.biz_type='activity' and exists(select 1 from kg_activity scoped_event where scoped_event.activity_id=kg_message.biz_id and scoped_event.store_id=selected_store.store_id)) or (kg_message.biz_type='ops_daily' and exists(select 1 from kg_ops_daily scoped_report where scoped_report.report_id=kg_message.biz_id and json_contains(scoped_report.store_ids,cast(selected_store.store_id as json)) and ((scoped_report.owner_id=#{recipientId} and scoped_report.role_code=#{selectedMessageRole}) or #{selectedMessageRole}='city_lead'))) or (kg_message.biz_type='ops_monthly' and exists(select 1 from kg_ops_monthly scoped_month where scoped_month.summary_id=kg_message.biz_id and json_contains(scoped_month.store_ids,cast(selected_store.store_id as json)) and ((scoped_month.owner_id=#{recipientId} and scoped_month.role_code=#{selectedMessageRole}) or #{selectedMessageRole}='city_lead'))) or (kg_message.biz_type='ops_scope' and #{selectedMessageRole} in ('keeper','manager','city_lead') and kg_message.route like concat('%role=',#{selectedMessageRole}) and exists(select 1 from kg_city scoped_city where scoped_city.city_id=kg_message.biz_id and (scoped_city.name=selected_store.city or scoped_city.full_name=selected_store.city))) )))

mapper.sql:
and (kg_message.mode<>'staff' or coalesce(kg_message.biz_type,'')<>'refund_trouble' or 1=1) and (kg_message.mode<>'staff' or (coalesce(kg_message.biz_type,'') not in ('stay_order','service_order') and coalesce(kg_message.route,'')<>'/pages/staff/stay-orders' and coalesce(kg_message.route,'') not like '/pages/staff/stay-orders?%')
or exists(select 1 from kg_store stay_message_store where stay_message_store.status='0' and stay_message_store.del_flag='0' and stay_message_store.store_id in #{stayMessageStore} and ((coalesce(kg_message.biz_type,'')<>'service_order' and exists(select 1 from kg_stay_order stay_message_order where stay_message_order.store_id=stay_message_store.store_id and ((kg_message.biz_type='stay_order' and stay_message_order.order_id=kg_message.biz_id) or (kg_message.route like '/pages/staff/stay-orders?%orderNo=%' and stay_message_order.order_no=substring_index(substring_index(concat(kg_message.route,'&'),'orderNo=',-1),'&',1))))) or (kg_message.biz_type='service_order' and exists(select 1 from kg_shop_order stay_message_service where stay_message_service.order_id=kg_message.biz_id and stay_message_service.store_id=stay_message_store.store_id)))) )

and (kg_message.mode<>'staff' or coalesce(kg_message.biz_type,'') not in ('insurance_finance','insurance_policy') or (1=0
or (kg_message.biz_type='insurance_finance' and exists(select 1 from kg_insurance_payment insurance_money where insurance_money.apply_id=kg_message.biz_id and insurance_money.payer_user_id=#{recipientId} and insurance_money.store_id in #{ims}))
or (kg_message.biz_type='insurance_policy' and exists(select 1 from kg_insurance_apply insurance_case where insurance_case.apply_id=kg_message.biz_id and insurance_case.store_id in #{ins})) ))

and (mode<>'staff' or coalesce(biz_type,'') not in ('application','online_submission','online_settlement') or not exists(select 1 from kg_application personal_application where personal_application.app_id=kg_message.biz_id and personal_application.app_user_id=kg_message.recipient_id))
and (exists(select 1 from sys_config fp where fp.config_key='kangaroo.private_chat.enabled' and binary fp.config_value='true') or ((coalesce(biz_type,'') <> 'chat_conv' or not exists(select 1 from kg_chat_conv hidden_private where hidden_private.conv_id=kg_message.biz_id and hidden_private.conv_type='private')) and (coalesce(category,'') <> 'chat' or (coalesce(biz_type,'')='chat_conv' and exists(select 1 from kg_chat_conv business_chat where business_chat.conv_id=kg_message.biz_id and business_chat.conv_type='store'))))) and (exists(select 1 from sys_config fg where fg.config_key='kangaroo.group_chat.enabled' and binary fg.config_value='true') or (coalesce(category,'') <> 'group' and not (coalesce(biz_type,'')='chat_conv' and exists( select 1 from kg_chat_conv hidden_group where hidden_group.conv_id=kg_message.biz_id and hidden_group.conv_type='group'))))
and (mode<>'staff' or (not exists(select 1 from kg_staff_grant restricted where restricted.app_user_id=#{recipientId} and restricted.role_code='online_staff' and restricted.status='0' and restricted.del_flag='0') and (not exists(select 1 from kg_staff_grant scoped where scoped.app_user_id=#{recipientId} and (scoped.role_code='merchant_service' or (scoped.role_code='city_lead' and not exists(select 1 from kg_role_switch switched where switched.id=1 and switched.phase='new'))) and scoped.status='0' and scoped.del_flag='0') or exists(select 1 from kg_staff_grant regular where regular.app_user_id=#{recipientId} and regular.role_code in ('manager','keeper','staff','merchant') and regular.status='0' and regular.del_flag='0'))) or biz_type='chat_conv'
or biz_type in ('stay_order','service_order') or kg_message.route='/pages/staff/stay-orders' or kg_message.route like '/pages/staff/stay-orders?%' or biz_type in ('grant','support_ticket','notice_reply','merchant_request','recruit_daily','ops_daily','ops_monthly','ops_scope')
or biz_type='staff_task'
or biz_type='stay_comment'
or biz_type in ('mediation','insurance_finance','insurance_policy')
or biz_type='reimburse'
or (biz_type in ('daily_report','activity_refund','refund_trouble','wallet','wallet_withdraw','birthday','gift_claim','appeal') and exists(select 1 from kg_role_switch switched where switched.id=1 and switched.phase='new') and exists(select 1 from kg_staff_grant lead_grant where lead_grant.app_user_id=#{recipientId} and lead_grant.role_code='city_lead' and lead_grant.status='0' and lead_grant.del_flag='0')) or (biz_type in ('application','online_submission') and exists( select 1 from kg_application a join kg_job j on j.job_id=a.job_id join kg_staff_grant g on g.store_id=a.store_id and g.app_user_id=#{recipientId} join kg_store st on st.store_id=g.store_id where a.app_id=kg_message.biz_id and a.del_flag='0' and j.store_id=a.store_id and g.status='0' and g.del_flag='0' and st.status='0' and st.del_flag='0' and g.role_code<>'city_lead' and (g.role_code not in ('online_staff','merchant_service') or j.job_type='online')))
or (biz_type='online_settlement' and exists( select 1 from kg_application a join kg_job j on j.job_id=a.job_id join kg_staff_grant g on g.store_id=a.store_id and g.app_user_id=#{recipientId} join kg_store st on st.store_id=g.store_id where a.app_id=kg_message.biz_id and a.del_flag='0' and j.store_id=a.store_id and j.job_type='online' and g.status='0' and g.del_flag='0' and st.status='0' and st.del_flag='0' and g.role_code not in ('city_lead','online_staff')))
or (biz_type='job' and (kg_message.route like '/pages/staff/online-jobs?%' or kg_message.route like '/pages/staff/applications?%jobType=online%') and exists( select 1 from kg_job j join kg_staff_grant g on g.store_id=j.store_id and g.app_user_id=#{recipientId} join kg_store st on st.store_id=g.store_id where j.job_id=kg_message.biz_id and j.job_type='online' and j.del_flag='0' and g.role_code<>'city_lead' and g.status='0' and g.del_flag='0' and st.status='0' and st.del_flag='0')))
and (biz_type <> 'chat_conv' or biz_type is null or exists( select 1 from kg_chat_conv c join kg_chat_member cm on cm.conv_id=c.conv_id where c.conv_id=kg_message.biz_id and c.conv_type<>'store' and cm.app_user_id=#{recipientId} and cm.left_time is null and ((kg_message.mode='staff' and cm.role in ('store','admin')) or (kg_message.mode='user' and cm.role not in ('store','admin'))) and (cm.role not in ('store','admin') or exists( select 1 from kg_activity a join kg_staff_grant g on g.store_id=a.store_id join kg_store st on st.store_id=g.store_id where a.activity_id=c.activity_id and g.app_user_id=#{recipientId} and g.status='0' and g.del_flag='0' and g.role_code not in ('online_staff','merchant_service','city_lead') and st.status='0' and st.del_flag='0')
or (exists(select 1 from kg_role_switch switched where switched.id=1 and switched.phase='new') and exists(select 1 from kg_staff_grant lead_seat where lead_seat.app_user_id=#{recipientId} and lead_seat.role_code='city_lead' and lead_seat.status='0' and lead_seat.del_flag='0'))) ) or exists( select 1 from kg_chat_conv c join kg_chat_member cm on cm.conv_id=c.conv_id join kg_app_user cu on cu.user_id=cm.app_user_id and cu.status='0' and cu.del_flag='0' join kg_store st on st.store_id=c.store_id and st.status='0' and st.del_flag='0' join kg_chat_member applicant on applicant.conv_id=c.conv_id and applicant.role='member' join kg_app_user au on au.user_id=applicant.app_user_id and au.status='0' and au.del_flag='0' where c.conv_id=kg_message.biz_id and c.conv_type='store' and cm.app_user_id=#{recipientId} and cm.left_time is null and ((kg_message.mode='staff' and cm.role in ('store','admin')) or (kg_message.mode='user' and cm.role not in ('store','admin'))) and (select count(*) from kg_chat_member only_one where only_one.conv_id=c.conv_id and only_one.role='member')=1 and (c.pair_key=concat('s',c.store_id,'-u',applicant.app_user_id) or (c.source='online_task' and c.pair_key=concat('o',c.store_id,'-u',applicant.app_user_id)) or (c.source='progress' and c.pair_key=concat('offline:',c.store_id,':u',applicant.app_user_id))) and ((cm.role='member' and cm.app_user_id=applicant.app_user_id) or (cm.role='store' and exists(select 1 from kg_role_switch switched where switched.id=1 and switched.phase='new') and exists(select 1 from kg_staff_grant lead_seat where lead_seat.app_user_id=cm.app_user_id and lead_seat.role_code='city_lead' and lead_seat.status='0' and lead_seat.del_flag='0')) or (cm.role='store' and exists( select 1 from kg_staff_grant g where g.store_id=c.store_id and g.app_user_id=cm.app_user_id and g.status='0' and g.del_flag='0' and g.role_code not in ('merchant_service','city_lead') and (g.role_code<>'online_staff' or c.source='online_task')
and (g.role_code<>'manager' or coalesce(g.granted_by,'')<>'system:merchant_request' or (c.source='progress' and c.pair_key=concat('offline:',c.store_id,':u',applicant.app_user_id))) and ( (c.source='progress' and c.pair_key=concat('offline:',c.store_id,':u',applicant.app_user_id)) or not exists(select 1 from kg_chat_reception cr where cr.store_id=c.store_id and (cr.first_id is not null or cr.second_id is not null)) or exists(select 1 from kg_chat_reception cr where cr.store_id=c.store_id and (cr.first_id=cm.app_user_id or cr.second_id=cm.app_user_id)) ) ))) ))

and (biz_type is null or biz_type <> 'chat_conv' or not exists( select 1 from kg_message newer where newer.biz_type='chat_conv' and newer.biz_id=kg_message.biz_id and newer.recipient_id=kg_message.recipient_id and newer.mode=kg_message.mode and newer.del_flag='0' and newer.msg_id>kg_message.msg_id))

(case when category in ('comment','like') then category when mode='staff' and (category in ('apply','interview','contract','staff') or (category='system' and coalesce(biz_type,'') like 'activity%')) then 'apply' when mode='staff' and category='order' then 'order' when category='system' and not (mode='user' and coalesce(biz_type,'') like 'activity%') then 'system' else 'main' end)

and (category not in ('comment','like') or ( ((biz_type in ('post','post_like') and exists( select 1 from kg_post ip where ip.post_id=kg_message.biz_id and ip.del_flag='0' and ip.status='online')) or (biz_type in ('comment','comment_like') and exists( select 1 from kg_post_comment ic join kg_post ip on ip.post_id=ic.post_id where ic.comment_id=kg_message.biz_id and ic.status='visible' and ic.del_flag='0' and ip.del_flag='0' and ip.status='online'))) and (actor_id is null or not exists( select 1 from kg_user_block ib where (ib.user_id=kg_message.recipient_id and ib.blocked_id=kg_message.actor_id) or (ib.user_id=kg_message.actor_id and ib.blocked_id=kg_message.recipient_id))) and (actor_id is null or exists( select 1 from kg_app_user iu where iu.user_id=kg_message.actor_id and iu.status='0' and iu.del_flag='0'))))
mapper.select: select count(1) from kg_message where and read_flag = '0'

where recipient_id = #{recipientId} and mode = 'user' and del_flag = '0' and biz_type = 'chat_conv'
and exists (select 1 from kg_application own_app join kg_chat_conv scoped_chat on scoped_chat.store_id = own_app.store_id and scoped_chat.conv_id = kg_message.biz_id where own_app.app_id = #{appId} and own_app.app_user_id = #{recipientId} and own_app.del_flag = '0' and scoped_chat.conv_type = 'store' and scoped_chat.source = 'progress' and scoped_chat.pair_key = concat('offline:', own_app.store_id, ':u', #{recipientId})) order by create_time desc, msg_id desc limit 1
select count(1) from kg_message where recipient_id = #{recipientId} and mode = #{mode} and read_flag = '0' and del_flag = '0'

select category, count(1) as total, sum(case when read_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as unread from kg_message where recipient_id = #{recipientId} and mode = #{mode} and del_flag = '0'
group by category

select x.msg_id, x.recipient_id, x.mode, x.category, x.title, x.content, x.biz_type, x.biz_id, x.actor_id, x.route, x.read_flag, x.read_time, x.del_flag, x.create_time,
case when au.user_id is null then null when au.nickname is null or au.nickname = '' then concat('用户', au.user_id) else au.nickname end as actor_name, au.avatar as actor_avatar, ip.post_id,
nullif(substring_index(coalesce(ip.images, ''), ',', 1), '') as cover, coalesce(nullif(ip.title, ''), left(ip.content, 30)) as post_title,
case when x.biz_type = 'comment_like' then left(ic.content, 60) when x.biz_type = 'comment' and ic.reply_user_id is not null then ( select left(rq.content, 60) from kg_post_comment rq where rq.post_id=ic.post_id and rq.app_user_id=ic.reply_user_id and (rq.comment_id=ic.parent_id or rq.parent_id=ic.parent_id) and rq.comment_id < ic.comment_id and rq.status='visible' and rq.del_flag='0' order by rq.comment_id desc limit 1) else null end as quote from ( select msg_id, recipient_id, mode, category, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, actor_id, route, read_flag, read_time, del_flag, create_time from kg_message where recipient_id = #{recipientId} and mode = #{mode} and del_flag = '0'
and category = #{category} and = #{bucket} order by create_time desc, msg_id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit} ) x left join kg_app_user au on x.category in ('comment','like') and au.user_id=x.actor_id left join kg_post_comment ic on x.category in ('comment','like') and x.biz_type in ('comment','comment_like') and ic.comment_id=x.biz_id left join kg_post ip on x.category in ('comment','like') and ip.post_id=(case when x.biz_type in ('comment','comment_like') then ic.post_id else x.biz_id end) order by x.create_time desc, x.msg_id desc

select t.bucket, count(1) as total, sum(case when t.read_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as unread from ( select as bucket, read_flag from kg_message where recipient_id = #{recipientId} and mode = #{mode} and del_flag = '0'
) t group by t.bucket
mapper.insert:
insert into kg_message
recipient_id, mode, category, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, actor_id, route, read_flag, del_flag, create_time
#{recipientId}, #{mode}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{actorId}, #{route}, #{readFlag}, #{delFlag}, sysdate()
mapper.update: update kg_message set read_flag = '1', read_time = sysdate() where msg_id = #{msgId} and recipient_id = #{recipientId} and (read_flag = '0' or read_time is null) and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where msg_id = #{msgId} and recipient_id = #{recipientId} and mode = #{mode} and del_flag = '0'

where msg_id = #{msgId} and recipient_id = #{recipientId} and mode = #{mode} and del_flag = '0'
for update
mapper.update: update kg_message set del_flag = '2' where recipient_id = #{recipientId} and mode = #{mode} and del_flag = '0' and (msg_id = #{msgId} or (biz_type = 'chat_conv' and biz_id = #{chatId} and msg_id < #{msgId}))
mapper.sql: recipient_id=#{recipientId} and mode='staff' and del_flag='0' and ='apply'
case when biz_type in ('application','online_submission','online_settlement') then (select app_user_id from kg_application where app_id=kg_message.biz_id and del_flag='0') end
mapper.select: select m.msg_id id,m.title,m.content,m.route,m.create_time createTime, t.personId,t.threadCount,t.unreadCount, coalesce(nullif(u.nickname,''),concat('报名人',t.personId)) personName from ( select max(q.msg_id) latestId,q.personId,count(*) threadCount,sum(q.read_flag='0') unreadCount,max(q.create_time) latestTime from (select msg_id,read_flag,create_time, personId from kg_message where ) q group by q.personId,case when q.personId is null then q.msg_id else 0 end order by latestTime desc,latestId desc limit #{offset},#{limit} ) t join kg_message m on m.msg_id=t.latestId left join kg_app_user u on u.user_id=t.personId order by t.latestTime desc,t.latestId desc
